S. no. Description of work Unit Qty Rate Amount 1. Deployment of 07 nos Battery-operated illu mination high mast tower with 04 Nos. LED Flood Light 200 W each with at least 8 Mete rs telescopic height along with adequate m anpower to deploy the light at mining site a s per instruction/requirement (i) Scope of Service: Deployment of Battery- operated lighting tower as per requirement. 07 Nos. battery operated high mast tower to be provided for 180 days dep loyment. (ii) Time of Deployment - Typically from 06 PM to 6.00 AM during the dark hours or as p er seasonal variation from sunset to sunrise . (iii) Vehicle for transport to and from deploy ment site will be in the scope of contractor provided vehicle must be as per mines stan dards (Camper-Van/Pickup Van/Mini Truck o r any suitable electric vehicle). (iv) Only power supply for battery charging and storage room will be provided by the depart ment-electricity bills for the battery chargin g to be paid by the contractor as per energ y consumption, installation of charging stat ion and accessories will be in the scope of c ontractor. (v) Operation and maintenance of the Lights, M ast and its accessories will be in the scope of contractor. Days 180

(vi) Manpower engaged for light operation and deployment should be well trained and mu st possess VTC/PME/Mine authorization to w ork at Mine from Colliery Manager and driv ers must possess valid driving license. (vii) Vehicle engaged for shifting of illumination mast must possess all statutory RTO Docu ments. (viii) Maintenance of battery charging station wil l be in the scope of contractor. (ix) All 07 Nos. Mast provided must have 01 ext ra spares battery ready for operation. (x) Theft of material such as lights, batteries a nd accessories if occurs, replacement of ne w/spares will be in the scope of contractor. (xi) The Lux values must follow DGMS Guideline for illumination standard of opencast mines . The light should give lux value of minimu m 15 Lux (Horizontal) and minimum 25 Lux (vertical) when measured at a distance of 8 0 Meter from the base of Pole fitted at a hei ght of 14 meters (Lot of supplied light will b e accepted only after successful testing of l ight.
